title: configEnvVar.test.ts mocks a module path that does not exist (vi.doMock("../../src/db")), so the real src/utils/db loads when the case imports the exit engine (before the rails: the live DB)

evidence.note: vi.doMock('../../src/db', ...) with statement names (insertExitState, updateExitState) that no longer exist
exitEngine imports ./utils/db, which the mis-pathed mock does not intercept

sibling_sites_checked: mockspec.js resolved all 349 vi.mock / vi.doMock / vi.unmock / vi.doUnmock specifiers in the 84 files (308 relative) against the base-SHA tree: this is the only one that resolves to no file. The SAFE-06 specifier gate (22-11) is the rail for this class.
severity_rationale: S3: the case still asserts the right config value; the defect is a silent mock miss that let the real DB module load (the reach is counted in AUD-TESTU-001) and will be caught by the SAFE-06 gate.
recommendation: Phase 28: point the mock at ../../src/utils/db with the current statement names (the SAFE-06 gate should already flag it).
affected_cases: custom STOP_LOSS_PCT flows through to exitConfig.stopLossPct
escaped_regression: Any import-time write added to src/utils/db.ts runs during this case while it stays green, because the mock it relies on never applies.
